en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Hamza Bin Al Qasim, from Ibrahim Bin Musa who said,
‘I urged upon Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> regarding something I sought from him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> used to promise me.

So, one day he<sup>asws</sup> went out to welcome the governor of Al-Medina, and I was with him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> went near the castle of so and so, and encamped beneath some trees, and I encamped with him<sup>asws</sup>, and there was no third (person) with us.
So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>. This is the Eid (festival day), and no, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, I do not own (even) a Dirham, nor (anything else) besides it’.

So he<sup>asws</sup> rubbed with his<sup>asws</sup> whip on the ground with an intense whipping, then struck his<sup>asws</sup> hand and grabbed a gold ingot from it, then said: ‘Benefit by it and conceal what you saw’.
